notes.title: Minor Update April 10th, 2023
notes.notes: I added a pop up to highlight some of the important mechanics to being a successful Dungeon Vendor. This was based on some early feedback the game has received. Once again, thank you for playing The Dungeon Vendor!

notes.title: The Dungeon Vendor Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that on Thursday, April 6th The Dungeon Vendor will be released. In preparation for that we have started up our [url=https://discord.gg/wz5ESP89rV]Discord[/url] and are looking forward to feedback on the game.

For me personally this has been a long pursuit, finally releasing my first game after teaching digital design and game design for over twenty years. I look forward to connecting with you all!
